Location: Bristol
Description:

A Shift Operations Technician is sought for a Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) Power Station located in Bristol. The role involves operations and monitoring of critical equipment using SCADA/DCS systems. Candidates with experience in heavy process engineering environments, such as power stations or oil & gas, and a relevant engineering qualification are encouraged to apply. Royal/Merchant Navy Marine Engineers seeking a watchkeeping role are also welcome. Salary offered is £51,606, increasing to £61,606 after probation, plus shift allowance and benefits.



Apply to this job
